description: Photovoltaic System Pricing Trends: Historical, Recent, and Near-Term Projections 2015 Edition is a data set deposited in DOE National Library of the Rockies (NLR) Repository by its authors David Feldman, Galen Barbose. This is the fourth edition in an annual briefing prepared jointly by LBNL and NREL intended to provide a high-level overview of historical, recent, and projected near-term PV system pricing trends in the United States. Coverage: national (US); the metadata date the deposit to 2016. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 1 files. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page.
